text.p: IKB Deutsche Industriebank AG said on Wednesday it expected satisfactory earnings in its 1996/1997 fiscal year to March 31 after raising its operating profit by 7.1 percent to 236.6 million marks in the first nine months.

Net interest income in the nine months to December 31 rose to 510.5 million marks from 487.4 million. Net commission income rose to 7.3 million marks from 5.7 million marks, the bank said in a statement.
Own-account trading income trebled to 11.3 million marks from 3.5 million. Administration costs rose to 175.8 million marks from 168.8 million marks, the bank said in a statement.
The balance sheet total grew to 45.59 billion marks from 44.8 billion.
IKB offers a range of banking services to industry, financing the operations of larger commercial and industrial companies of the medium-sized business sector.
